intent: Wire one real, ordinary Hermes chat-completion execution path in the isolated OMNIS WING fork through the R1 ABSOLUTE-shaped OutboundEnvelope evaluator and broker, then prove the actual path refuses protected project content before any fake provider call.
audience: JourdanLabs Captain and independent gate deciding whether OMNIS WING is advancing from a boundary harness into a real governed agent host.
role: a senior Hermes integration engineer making the smallest traceable production-path change with deterministic local fakes and no live provider configuration
done:
Identifies and documents one normal non-streaming Hermes user chat-completion path from its host entry through the existing client invocation
Routes that exact path through omnis_wing.absolute.host.dispatch_outbound before the provider client is invoked
Builds the OutboundEnvelope from the exact final user/model message bytes that the fake provider receives, including source provenance, declared destination, modality chat, lane, policy version, and coverage class
Uses an injected local fake provider/client only; no network, credentials, router, or live Hermes profile
Proves through the real selected Hermes path that protected project source + CN destination returns REFUSE_RESIDENCY and fake client call count is zero
Proves missing source provenance returns REFUSE_SOURCE_POLICY and fake client call count is zero
Proves explicit generic source + permitted destination reaches the fake client exactly once and its received bytes equal the evaluated envelope payload bytes
Proves the selected legacy direct client invocation cannot be reached when the WING dispatch is installed: a planted bypass or mock assertion fails
Adds selected real-path files to the coverage manifest as governed_r2 and leaves every other Hermes path visibly outside_r2
Keeps R1/R1.1 tests green and adds cold R2 integration tests
Writes BUILD_HANDOFF.md with CADMUS SHA, exact selected call path, source files changed, all test commands, fake-client evidence, and non-claims
non_goals:
Modifying ~/.hermes/hermes-agent or the Videl live installation
Calling any real provider, reading/copying credentials, starting a real session, or changing Hermes global model configuration
Claiming all Hermes chat paths, streaming, images, tools, MCP, retries, compression, fallback providers, or plugins are governed
Receipt signing/chain/anchor, full source-taint propagation, packaging, publishing, pushing, or full TERMINUS ABSOLUTE certification
constraints:
Build only in ~/projects/omnis-wing on top of the R1.1 fork; preserve its existing non-claims
The selected path must be a real current Hermes call chain, not a new standalone adapter that production code never imports
No direct raw provider call may remain reachable on the selected path after WING dispatch is enabled
The envelope canonical bytes must be the bytes supplied to the fake provider after policy evaluation; provider SDK-added fields are outside R2 and must be labelled
Protected project source provenance must be explicit and derived at the selected path test seam, not inferred from a filename alone
Use decision/phase grammar from R1; no SENT shorthand
All gates run cold and offline; builder and independent gate remain separate
If no ordinary path can be safely isolated without live configuration, stop with REFUSED_AS_UNSAFE and show the blocking chain rather than selecting an unrelated helper
format: A commit in ~/projects/omnis-wing with a narrowly wired real Hermes chat path, deterministic integration fixtures, coverage-manifest delta, BUILD_HANDOFF.md, and a READY_FOR_GATE or REFUSED_AS_UNSAFE result. Every artifact binds to this input SHA-256.
